解放貝斯與托特，保留拉神。歐西里斯出場時同時回收巴絲特與門前守衛。: Tribute Bes and Thoth; keep Ra. When Osiris arrives, recover both Bastet and Gatekeeper.
蓋下回收的門前守衛，交回合；賽特攻擊歐西里斯時降攻700。: Set the recovered Gatekeeper and end your turn. When Set attacks Osiris, lower his ATK by 700.
下個自己回合才讓拉神支付800加攻，不選效果破壞，也不提早消耗本回合強化。: Wait until your next turn for Ra to pay 800 and gain ATK. Do not choose effect destruction or waste this turn's boost early.

40張固定混合借卡，保留自選牌組。回收、等待伏兵可用、反擊與拉神下一回合的付費突: Use this stage’s 40-card cooperative tutorial deck; your own deck stays unchanged. Recover your cards, counter with the Ambush, then pay Life for Ra’s breakthrough on the next turn, in that order.
兩條神殿通道在日輪下交會。卡里姆帶著尚未耗盡的力量抵達，莎爾瑪抱著留有空白的名字: Two temple paths met beneath the sun disc. Karim arrived with strength to spare, while Salma held her book of names with blank spaces still inside. Set's afterimage entwined with Apep's projection, and their joined chaos blocked the exit and morning light.
我不再答應一個人扛到最後。這裡只剩2000LP的餘力，我想先聽你需要什麼。: I will not promise to carry everything alone to the end again. We only have 2000 Life left. First, I want to hear what you need.
我想先請歐西里斯接回巴絲特與門前守衛。讓巴絲特休息，讓伏兵等到真正能用的時候。你: I want Osiris to bring back Bastet and Gatekeeper first. Let Bastet rest and wait until the Ambush is truly ready. Will you hold with me through this turn?
你等她，她等你。只要有一個人肯立刻把所有都交出來，你們就不必聽彼此的猶豫。: You wait for her, and she waits for you. If just one of you gives everything now, you can stop listening to each other's doubts.
先解放貝斯與托特，保留拉神。我回收的伏兵能替下一回合留下反擊；回來的巴絲特不必再: Tribute Bes and Thoth first, and keep Ra. The Ambush I recover will leave room for a counterattack next turn. Bastet need not be rushed back into action.
等這道攻勢過去，我再支付800，將力量用在真正能打開道路的時刻。兩份力量各自完成: Once this attack has passed, I will pay 800 and use my strength when it can truly open the way. We can each do our part without turning our two strengths into one person's promise.
記住同伴，也替同伴留下明天。我們先怎麼回應這一次交會？: Remember our companions, and leave them a tomorrow too. How shall we answer this meeting?
門前守衛削弱賽特殘影的攻勢，歐西里斯接住反擊。下一次日輪升起時，拉神才燃起力量，: Gatekeeper weakened Set's afterimage, and Osiris held through the attack and fought back. When the sun disc rose again, Ra finally kindled his strength and broke the Chaos Confluence projection wrapped in Apep's coils.
名字簿還在，巴絲特也還在手中。我沒有要求她再做一次什麼，才准她留下。: The book of names is still here, and Bastet is still in my hand. I did not make her earn her place by doing one more thing.
1200LP也還留著。我想把這份餘力帶回去，陪大家走完回家的路。: We still have 1200 Life too. I want to take that strength home and walk the rest of the way with everyone.
記住不是把人固定在過去；今夜留下的位置，明天仍能由他自己選擇。: Remembering someone does not mean keeping them in the past. The place we leave for them tonight is still theirs to choose tomorrow.
黑夜仍會再來。今日守住了循環，不等於永遠消滅混沌；下一次也可以彼此求援。: Night will come again. We protected the cycle today; we did not end chaos forever. Next time, we can ask each other for help again.
那就先一起回去吧。等我想再向前時，我會親口告訴你。: Then let us go home together. When I am ready to go further, I will tell you myself.
莎爾瑪在空白頁寫下兩人的相遇，沒有替任何人寫定結局。卡里姆等她合上名字簿，兩人並: Salma wrote their meeting on a blank page without deciding anyone's ending. Karim waited until she closed the book of names, then they walked side by side down the sunlit steps.
先把需要與分工說清楚: Explain what we need and who will do what
你保留拉神，我請歐西里斯回收並備好伏兵。先接住賽特殘影的攻擊，下一回合再由拉神突: Keep Ra safe. I will have Osiris recover our resources and prepare the Ambush. We take the attack from Set's afterimage first, then Ra breaks through the chaos next turn.
我們都說出了需要，也完成了答應的事。這段路不用再由誰獨自承擔。: We both said what we needed and did what we promised. Neither of us has to carry this journey alone.
先替同伴留下休息與歸途: Leave our companions time to rest and a way home
讓巴絲特回到手中休息，讓伏兵有時間準備。拉神等下一回合才支付800，留下1200: Let Bastet rest in your hand and give the Ambush time to get ready. Ra waits until next turn to pay 800, leaving 1200 Life so everyone can go home together.
你沒有催促回來的人，也沒有把力量耗盡。名字與黎明，都有了能繼續走下去的地方。: You did not rush those who returned or use up all your strength. Our names and the dawn both have a way to carry on.
把黎明留給同行的人: Leave the Dawn for Those Beside You
學會付出、求援與休整，也留下能和伙伴走到明天的力量。: Learn to give, ask for help and rest, while keeping enough strength to reach tomorrow with your companions.
渡口還有人。我把力量給你，多少都……等等，你還沒有能落腳的地方。: There are still people at the crossing. I will give you my strength, whatever it takes... Wait. You have nowhere to stand yet.
先看清我能站在哪裡。把那裡留給我，你也留一點力氣，我們才走得下去。: Check where I can stand first. Leave that place for me, and keep some strength for yourself. That is how we keep going.
我還走得動。原來不用倒在這裡，才能證明我真的想救人。: I can still walk. I do not have to collapse here to prove I really want to save them.
那就過來。我站穩了，你也別落下。: Then come here. I have found my footing. You must not get left behind either.
那道咒印朝烏普瓦烏特去了。拜託你護住他……你能替他擋住哪一部分？: That curse is heading for Wepwawet. Please protect him... Which part of it can you stop?
這一次破壞我能擋。接下來的交鋒還得靠他，別告訴他什麼都不會發生。: I can stop this destruction. The fight after that is still his to face. Do not tell him nothing will happen.
他反擊了。我剛才差點又說，你一定不會有事。: He fought back. I almost told him again that he would be completely safe.
那就換一句。告訴他，我們都在看著，還需要什麼就開口。: Then say something else. Tell him we are watching, and he can ask for whatever else he needs.
她要我衝過去。我知道這是挑釁，可一停下，就像把大家的希望放掉了。: She wants me to charge. I know it is a taunt, but stopping feels like letting go of everyone's hopes.
看看烏普瓦烏特。他換個站姿就能守住。先讓他站穩，你不用替她證明什麼。: Look at Wepwawet. A change of stance is enough for him to hold. Let him get steady first. You have nothing to prove to her.
我們等到了。他還站著，比我立刻出手重要。: We made it through. He is still standing. That matters more than me striking right away.
記住你剛才看見的，下次別只聽見挑釁。: Remember what you just saw. Next time, hear more than the taunts.
我想請你來，可我怕又變成……把我的擔子全丟給另一個人。: I want to ask you to come, but I am afraid I will just... dump my whole burden on someone else again.
先說清楚哪裡需要我。我會來，眼前這道門，讓已在你身邊的人先開。: Tell me where you need me first. I will come. Let those already beside you open this door.
我把你找到了，也把下一段的準備留好了。這次沒有只喊一聲救命就停下。: I found you and got the next step ready too. This time, I did more than just call for help.
我收到了。等輪到我時，叫我的名字。: I hear you. When it is my turn, call my name.
先讓眼前的伙伴突破，再替我留出場的位置。不要急。: Let the companions here break through first. Then make room for me to enter. There is no rush.
你沒有催我立刻承擔。我知道自己該在哪裡接上。: You did not rush me into taking over. I know where I can join you.
那就把你做不到的地方說給我聽。我們從那裡接手。: Then tell me what you cannot do alone. We can pick things up from there.
你開了口，卻沒有把自己扔在路上。我們能一起走。: You asked for help without giving up on yourself. We can walk together.
我想說不用休息，可你們都看著我……我連這句話都說得很勉強了。: I want to say I do not need a rest, but you are all looking at me... Even saying that feels like a struggle now.
別說了，把手給我。卜塔會接前面的路，這一會兒你讓我照料。: Enough. Give me your hand. Ptah will take care of the road ahead. Let me look after you for a moment.
原來被照顧的時候，我不用先答應之後一定會還。: So when someone looks after me, I do not have to promise to pay it all back first.
先把氣喘順。我們沒有在算你欠多少。: Catch your breath first. We are not keeping count of what you owe.
好，先讓他照料你。前面我來，別急著又把剛補回的力氣交出去。: Good. Let him care for you first. I will take the front. Do not rush to give away the strength you just recovered.
你終於沒有在我伸手時躲開。: You finally did not pull away when I offered my hand.
你先休息。我和庫努姆把下一段接起來，準備好了會叫你。: You rest first. Khnum and I will prepare the next stretch. We will call when we are ready.
前面的路接上了，你也還在我們中間。: The way ahead is ready, and you are still here with us.
我想把原先失落的凱布利接回來。可是接回之後呢？我不能再只想著叫他衝上去。: I want to bring back the Khepri we lost earlier. But what comes after that? I cannot just think about sending him charging ahead again.
我帶他回來，你給他一個能守住的位置。讓每一步都有著落。: I will bring him back. You give him a place where he can defend. Make sure every step has somewhere to lead.
我認得他。不是隨便找一個人補上空位，是他真的回來了。: I know him. I am not just finding someone to fill a gap. It really is him, back with us.
他站穩了。你可以走近一點，讓他看見你。: He has found his footing. Go a little closer and let him see you.
先把他接回，再替他留守備的位置。今天不必急著證明能打。: Bring him back first, then leave him a place to defend. He does not have to prove he can fight right away today.
他沒有一回來就被推向前面。: He was not pushed to the front the moment he came back.
好。先把出場和回來的路一一準備妥當，我跟著你的安排。: All right. Prepare his arrival and his way back, one step at a time. I will follow your plan.
你沒有漏掉他落腳的那一步。現在他真的在這裡。: You did not skip the step that gave him a place to stand. Now he really is here.
她叫我把全部力量都燒掉。我差點信了……可明天，大家還得走路。: She told me to burn all my strength. I almost believed her... But everyone still has to walk tomorrow.
看她防線的弱處。只把力量用在那裡，別用自己的一切替她點火。: Look for the weak point in her defense. Use your strength only there. Do not burn everything you are just to light her fire.
路開了。我沒有聽她的，把明天也一起燒掉。: The way is open. I did not listen to her and burn tomorrow away too.
那就把剩下的力量帶走。神殿頂端還有黑影。: Then take your remaining strength with you. There is still a shadow above the temple.
先看清防線，讓我削弱它。開出路就走，不必追求更大的破壞。: Study the defense first and let me weaken it. Once the way is open, go. You do not need to destroy more.
缺口就在那裡。你沒有多燒掉一份明天。: There is the opening. You did not burn away another piece of tomorrow.
把歸途需要的力氣留好。剩下的，才交給這一道障礙。: Keep the strength you need to get home. Only what is left goes toward this obstacle.
你還走得動。這次算進去的，也有回家的路。: You can still walk. This time, your plan included the way home too.
阿佩普的投影盤住太陽神殿。日輪落入巨蛇的陰影，卡里姆握著神籙，剩下的力量已不容他: Apep's projection coiled around the Sun Temple. The great serpent shadowed the sun disc. Karim gripped Shenlu; he could no longer afford to keep burning away his remaining strength.
日輪都被遮住了。我不能說黑夜從此不會來……但我想帶大家走完今晚。: Even the sun disc is hidden. I cannot promise that night will never return... But I want to get everyone through tonight.
先讓阿蒙接住夜咒。等這一陣過去，我再升起光。你的承諾，留給身旁的人。: Let Amun take the night curse first. Once it passes, I will raise my light. Save your promise for those beside you.
阿蒙接住夜咒後，拉神等夜咒散去，才升起光芒，擊破阿佩普的投影。巨蛇退回夜色，神殿: Amun took the night curse. Ra waited for it to fade, then raised his light and broke Apep's projection. The serpent withdrew into the night, revealing the passable stone steps outside the temple once more.
還能看見石階。我們別停在這裡，河岸的人在等。: We can still see the steps. Let us not stop here. People are waiting by the river.
走吧。今夜的光已經夠你們回去，不需要誰留在這裡燃盡。: Go. Tonight's light is enough to guide you home. No one needs to stay here and burn themselves out.
那就一起守這一夜。先護住阿蒙，等夜咒過去再叫我。: Then let us hold on together tonight. Protect Amun first, and call me when the night curse has passed.
天亮時，你沒有獨自倒在神殿前。: At dawn, you had not collapsed alone before the temple.
好。把回去的力氣留著，光不必燒到最後一滴。: Good. Keep enough strength to go home. The light need not burn down to the last drop.
你還能伸手扶人。那就是留下力量的地方。: You can still reach out to help someone. That is what you kept that strength for.
你抱著那本簿子一路過來，手都沒鬆過。現在需要我守哪裡？: You carried that book all this way without letting go once. Where do you need me to hold now?
先陪我等巴絲特安穩。歐西里斯接回援手，你保住拉神，等我們準備好了再開路。: Stay with me until Bastet is settled. Osiris will bring our help back. Keep Ra safe, and open the way once we are ready.
我想把剩下的力氣帶回河岸。有人還在等我們扶一把。: I want to take my remaining strength back to the riverbank. There are still people waiting for a helping hand.
那我把筆帶上。走到哪裡，讓他們自己告訴我們。: Then I will bring my pen. Wherever we go, let them tell us for themselves.
你保住拉神，我備好接應。眼前這一陣先一起守，之後再開路。: Keep Ra safe while I prepare our support. We hold through this wave together, then open the way.
你等到我回應，才往前。我沒有被留在後面。: You waited for my answer before moving forward. I was not left behind.
讓巴絲特先歇。拉神的力量等到能突破時再用，我們都得走回去。: Let Bastet rest first. Save Ra's strength until it can break through. All of us must make it home.
巴絲特歇下了，你也還走得動。回去吧。: Bastet is resting, and you can still walk too. Let us go home.
